x: The camp is run and organised by the Southern Counties A.A.A. under its administrator Tony Ward and aided by Ron Pickering and six other A.A.A.
It covers a wide range of subjects and its contributors include such notables as Bruce Tulloh, Tony Ward, Tom McNab and our own Ranjit Bhatia, who contributes a chapter on distance running in India.
Handbook, MIDDLE DISTANCE RUNNING by Tony Ward; STRENGTH TRAINING by Ron Pickering; CIRCUIT TRAINING by Adamson and Morgan; THE COMPLETE MIDDLE DISTANCE RUNNER by Messrs.
